title: Smallest freight capacity
short_description: A barge carries crates in their given order over D voyages. Each voyage takes a consecutive run of crates. Find the smallest load capacity that finishes all crates in at most D voyages.
normalized_description: Given positive ordered weights and a group limit D, minimize capacity so the sequence can be partitioned into at most D contiguous groups, each with sum at most capacity.

title: Balanced workshop shifts
short_description: Jobs with fixed durations must remain in order. Assign every job to exactly K nonempty consecutive shifts and minimize the duration of the busiest shift.
normalized_description: Partition a positive duration array into exactly K nonempty contiguous groups and minimize the maximum group sum, where K does not exceed the array length.

title: Longest affordable visit streak
short_description: Daily admission prices are positive. Choose consecutive days whose total price is within a budget and maximize the number of chosen days.
normalized_description: Given positive array values and a budget, find the maximum length contiguous subarray with sum at most the budget.

title: Shortest complete badge run
short_description: An exhibition logs badge colors in arrival order. Find the shortest consecutive log fragment containing every color required by a supplied set.
normalized_description: Find a minimum length contiguous sequence segment containing at least one occurrence of each required symbol; irrelevant and repeated symbols are allowed.

title: Closest gift pair
short_description: Gift prices are already sorted. Pick two different gifts whose total price is at most a budget and as large as possible.
normalized_description: Given sorted positive values, maximize the sum of two distinct positions subject to an upper sum limit.

title: Merge timestamp feeds
short_description: Two sensors provide nondecreasing timestamp lists. Output their combined sorted list, keeping repeated timestamps.
normalized_description: Merge two sorted sequences into a single nondecreasing sequence retaining all multiplicities.

title: Static ledger totals
short_description: Account entries may be positive or negative and never change. Answer many inclusive interval-total requests.
normalized_description: Given an immutable signed integer array, answer many sum queries over inclusive contiguous index ranges.

title: Garden rectangle totals
short_description: A grid records crop counts in each plot. Counts stay fixed. Report the sum inside each requested axis-aligned rectangle.
normalized_description: Given a fixed numeric matrix, answer many rectangle sum queries using inclusive row and column boundaries.

title: Batch irrigation increments
short_description: Each irrigation instruction adds an amount to every plot in an inclusive consecutive range. After all instructions, output every plot's final water amount.
normalized_description: Apply many additive interval updates to an initially zero array and report the complete array only after all updates; no intermediate queries occur.

title: Route occupancy
short_description: Each booking occupies one seat from its boarding stop until just before its exit stop. Calculate occupancy on every segment after all bookings are known.
normalized_description: Given half-open integer intervals, count how many intervals cover each adjacent-position segment after processing all intervals.

title: Count balanced ledger fragments
short_description: Signed ledger entries arrive in a fixed order. Count all nonempty consecutive fragments whose entries sum to zero.
normalized_description: Count the number of nonempty contiguous subarrays with sum zero in a signed integer array.

title: Count shared inventory codes
short_description: Two warehouses list item codes with duplicates. For each code, pair items across warehouses without reusing an item and report the total number of pairs.
normalized_description: Given two multisets of symbols, compute the sum of the minimum of their occurrence counts for every symbol.

title: Fewest supply stops
short_description: A rover follows a fixed route with sorted supply stations. Its tank has a fixed range and every stop fully refills it. Minimize refills or report impossibility.
normalized_description: Given a destination, ordered station positions, and fixed travel range per full tank, minimize full-refill stops along the line.

title: One-slot deadline jobs
short_description: Each job lasts one time slot and earns one reward if completed before its integer deadline. Choose a feasible subset with greatest total reward.
normalized_description: Select unit-duration jobs with deadlines and nonnegative profits to maximize reward while scheduling at most one job in each time slot.

title: Largest meeting selection
short_description: A room receives meeting requests with start and finish times. Choose as many meetings as possible; a meeting may start when another finishes.
normalized_description: Select a maximum cardinality subset of half-open intervals with no overlapping interiors.

title: Compact painted coverage
short_description: Several closed intervals on a number line are painted. Output disjoint merged intervals describing exactly the painted set.
normalized_description: Given closed intervals, merge all intersecting intervals and output their union as sorted disjoint intervals.

title: Fewest maze moves
short_description: A rectangular maze has blocked cells. From a start cell, reach a target using unit-cost horizontal or vertical moves, or report unreachable.
normalized_description: Find the shortest path length between two cells of a grid with obstacles and four unit-cost movement directions.

title: Smallest spelling journey
short_description: A dictionary permits replacing one character at a time, provided each intermediate word is in the dictionary. Minimize replacements from one word to another.
normalized_description: Find a minimum number of edges between two vertices in an implicit unweighted graph where equal-length dictionary words are adjacent if one character differs.

title: Cheapest road journey
short_description: Cities are connected by directed roads with nonnegative tolls. Find the cheapest journey from a supplied origin to a target.
normalized_description: Find a minimum total edge weight path from one source to a target in a directed graph with nonnegative weights.

title: Courier travel times
short_description: A depot serves a network of roads with nonnegative travel times. Compute the minimum travel time from the depot to every junction.
normalized_description: Find shortest distances from one source to all vertices in a graph with nonnegative edge weights; mark unreachable vertices.

title: Online friendship groups
short_description: People start alone. Friendship links are added over time. After each addition, report how many connected groups remain.
normalized_description: Maintain the number of connected components of an undirected graph under edge insertions only, starting with isolated vertices.

title: Redundant cable count
short_description: Install undirected cables one by one between computers. Count cables whose endpoints were already connected before installation.
normalized_description: For each inserted undirected edge, determine whether its endpoints were in the same connected component before insertion; count redundant edges.

title: Cheapest stair ascent
short_description: Every stair has a nonnegative landing fee. Starting below the first stair, move one or two stairs at a time and reach the final stair with minimum total fee.
normalized_description: Find a minimum cost path through ordered positions when each move advances one or two positions and each visited position contributes its given cost.

title: Fewest text edits
short_description: Convert one string into another using single-character insertion, deletion, or substitution. Each operation costs one.
normalized_description: Compute the minimum number of unit-cost insertions, deletions, and substitutions transforming one finite character sequence into another.

title: Best expedition load
short_description: Every piece of equipment has a weight and benefit. Each item may be packed at most once. Maximize benefit within the carrying capacity.
normalized_description: Choose a subset of indivisible items with integer weights and values to maximize total value subject to an upper total weight limit.

title: Unordered fare payments
short_description: A fare can be paid using unlimited coins from distinct positive denominations. Count unordered combinations reaching exactly the fare.
normalized_description: Count multisets of positive coin denominations whose weighted sum equals a target, with unlimited copies of each denomination and order ignored.

title: Longest rising readings
short_description: Readings appear chronologically. Keep as many readings as possible in their original order with each kept value strictly greater than the previous one.
normalized_description: Find the maximum length strictly increasing subsequence of a numeric sequence; chosen positions need not be contiguous.

title: Longest nesting chain
short_description: Envelopes have width and height and cannot be rotated. Find the longest chain where each next envelope is strictly larger in both dimensions.
normalized_description: Find a longest chain of two-dimensional pairs with both coordinates strictly increasing; equal coordinates cannot nest.

title: Wait for a warmer reading
short_description: For each day's temperature, report how many later days pass before the first strictly warmer day, or zero if none exists.
normalized_description: For each sequence position, find the nearest later position with a strictly greater value and report the index distance.

title: Largest skyline rectangle
short_description: Adjacent skyline bars all have unit width. Find the largest axis-aligned rectangle lying completely beneath the bars.
normalized_description: Given nonnegative heights of adjacent unit-width histogram bars, maximize rectangle area contained under consecutive bars.

title: Department team totals
short_description: A rooted company tree assigns a value to each employee. Compute the sum for each employee's entire descendant team, including that employee.
normalized_description: For every vertex of a rooted tree with signed vertex values, calculate the sum of all values in its subtree.

title: Distances from the root
short_description: A connected undirected tree has positive edge lengths. Report each vertex's distance from a chosen root.
normalized_description: Given a weighted tree and one root, compute the sum of edge lengths along the unique path from the root to every vertex.

title: Valid build order
short_description: Build targets depend on other targets. Output an ordering in which all prerequisites precede their users, or report a dependency cycle.
normalized_description: Given a directed prerequisite graph, produce a vertex ordering respecting every edge or report that no such ordering exists.

title: Minimum parallel semesters
short_description: Every course lasts one semester and there is no enrollment cap. Prerequisites must be finished in earlier semesters. Find the minimum semesters or report a cycle.
normalized_description: Given directed prerequisite edges and unit-duration vertices executable in parallel, minimize completion layers with prerequisites strictly earlier; detect cycles.

title: Best activity calendar
short_description: On each day choose one of three activities with different rewards. The same activity cannot be chosen on consecutive days. Maximize total reward.
normalized_description: Select one state per day from three reward options, forbid equal states on adjacent days, and maximize the total reward.

title: Best one-way grid walk
short_description: A robot starts in the top-left corner of a reward grid. It can move only right or down. Maximize collected reward when reaching the bottom-right corner.
normalized_description: Find a maximum weight path across a numeric matrix from top-left to bottom-right using only right and down steps, including endpoint values.

title: Live sensor adjustments
short_description: A row of sensors holds signed readings. Operations arrive interleaved: either overwrite one sensor's reading or ask for the total of readings between two sensor positions inclusive.
normalized_description: Maintain a signed array under single-position assignments interleaved with inclusive contiguous range-sum queries; answer each query against the current values.

title: Coldest stretch lookups
short_description: A fixed log of daily temperatures never changes. Many questions each name two days and ask for the lowest temperature recorded between them inclusive.
normalized_description: Given an immutable numeric array, answer many inclusive contiguous range-minimum queries.

title: Most profitable bookings
short_description: A hall receives booking offers, each with a start time, end time and fee. Accept a set of offers whose times do not overlap and earn the largest total fee.
normalized_description: Select pairwise nonoverlapping half-open intervals, each with a nonnegative value, maximizing the total value of the selected intervals.

title: Counting islands
short_description: A map grid marks each cell as land or water. Land cells sharing an edge belong to the same island. Report how many islands the map contains.
normalized_description: Count connected components of marked cells in a grid under four-directional adjacency.

title: Free and paid corridors
short_description: A building's corridors are directed. Some corridors are free to use, others cost exactly one token. Find the fewest tokens needed to walk from the entrance to the exit.
normalized_description: Find a minimum-cost path between two vertices of a directed graph where every edge weight is either zero or one.

title: Routes with rebates
short_description: Some one-way roads charge a toll and some pay a rebate, so road values may be negative. From the depot, compute the cheapest total to each town, or report that a loop can lower costs forever.
normalized_description: Compute single-source minimum path costs in a directed graph whose edge weights may be negative, or report a reachable negative-weight cycle.

title: Cheapest cable network
short_description: Villages can be joined by cables of given installation prices. Choose cables so every village is linked to every other, directly or indirectly, at minimum total price.
normalized_description: Select edges of a weighted undirected graph that connect all vertices with minimum total edge weight.

title: Longest fresh run
short_description: Given a line of text, find the length of the longest stretch of consecutive characters in which no character appears twice.
normalized_description: Find the maximum length contiguous substring containing no repeated character.

title: Two receipts that match
short_description: A shuffled pile of receipts lists amounts in no particular order. Find two different receipts whose amounts add up exactly to a given target.
normalized_description: Given an unsorted integer array and a target, find two distinct positions whose values sum exactly to the target.

title: Shared melody
short_description: Two melodies are written as note sequences. Find the length of the longest sequence of notes appearing in both melodies in the same order, though not necessarily adjacent.
normalized_description: Compute the length of the longest common subsequence of two sequences; matched positions need not be contiguous.

title: Exact weight check
short_description: A scale must show an exact target weight using some of the available weights, each at most once. Decide whether this is possible.
normalized_description: Decide whether some subset of positive integers, each used at most once, sums exactly to a target.

title: Spread-out towers
short_description: Candidate tower sites lie along a straight road. Build exactly K towers at candidate sites so that the closest pair of towers is as far apart as possible.
normalized_description: Choose K positions from given points on a line maximizing the minimum distance between any two chosen positions.

title: Closest shared ancestor
short_description: A family tree is rooted at its oldest member. Answer many questions, each naming two people, with the closest relative who is an ancestor of both.
normalized_description: Answer many lowest common ancestor queries for pairs of vertices in a rooted tree.

title: Two rival teams
short_description: Some pairs of players refuse to share a team. Decide whether everyone can be split into two teams so that no refusing pair ends up together.
normalized_description: Decide whether an undirected graph is bipartite, two-coloring vertices so no edge joins equal colors.

title: Scoreboard bonuses
short_description: Teams sit in a numbered row. Judges repeatedly award bonus points to one team, and spectators repeatedly ask for the combined score of the first k teams.
normalized_description: Support point additions to an array interleaved with prefix-sum queries over the current values.

title: Tallest wave lookups
short_description: A buoy recorded wave heights for a season; the log is archived and never edited. Many questions each give two positions and ask for the highest wave between them.
normalized_description: For a list of measurements that is never edited, report the largest value inside each of many requested windows between two positions, both included.

title: Arbitrage alarm
short_description: Exchange routes between assets have signed gains or losses. Decide whether some sequence of routes returns to its starting asset with a total that keeps decreasing cost forever.
normalized_description: Decide whether a directed graph with possibly negative edge weights contains a negative-weight cycle.

title: Climbing the family line
short_description: A lineage tree is rooted at the founder. Answer many questions of the form: who is the ancestor exactly k generations above this person, if any?
normalized_description: Answer many k-th ancestor queries in a rooted tree, reporting none when the depth is smaller than k.

title: Paint bucket
short_description: A pixel image and a starting pixel are given. Recolour the starting pixel and every pixel of the same original colour reachable through edge-sharing neighbours.
normalized_description: Recolour the connected region of equal-valued grid cells containing a start cell under four-directional adjacency.

title: Pairs with a set price gap
short_description: A shuffled list of product prices is given. Count the pairs of different positions whose prices differ by exactly a given amount.
normalized_description: Count unordered pairs of distinct positions in an unsorted integer array whose values differ by exactly a given amount.

title: Gentlest longest cable
short_description: Towers must all be linked by cables of known lengths. Choose cables so every tower is connected and the longest chosen cable is as short as possible.
normalized_description: Connect all vertices of a weighted undirected graph while minimizing the maximum chosen edge weight.

title: Wall breaker
short_description: A maze grid has open cells and walls. Moving into an open cell is free; moving into a wall breaks it at a cost of one hammer. Find the fewest hammers from start to exit.
normalized_description: Find a minimum-cost path between two grid cells where entering an open cell costs zero and entering a blocked cell costs one.
